# Read Only View

> Read Only View is an Obsidian community plugin that keeps selected Markdown notes and folders in Reading view to help prevent accidental edits.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://mrkazzila.github.io/Read-Only-View/)
- [Make one note read-only](https://mrkazzila.github.io/Read-Only-View/guides/make-note-read-only)
- [Make a folder read-only](https://mrkazzila.github.io/Read-Only-View/guides/make-folder-read-only)
- [Keep all notes in Reading view](https://mrkazzila.github.io/Read-Only-View/guides/make-all-notes-read-only)
- [Prevent accidental editing](https://mrkazzila.github.io/Read-Only-View/guides/prevent-accidental-editing)
- [Mobile Reading view](https://mrkazzila.github.io/Read-Only-View/guides/mobile-reading-view)

## Project

- GitHub: [https://github.com/mrKazzila/Read-Only-View](https://github.com/mrKazzila/Read-Only-View)
- Obsidian plugin: Read Only View

## Important

Read Only View controls Obsidian's Reading/Edit view behavior.
It does not modify operating-system file permissions or provide filesystem-level locking.
